findings.title: Per-Coordinator permanent recovery stop on any ambiguous IPC result (no retry, no reset within that Coordinator's lifetime)

findings.interpretation: A single ambiguous IPC (e.g. one SendRequest failure or timeout on the TF_SYNC,1 channel) permanently disables host-window recovery for that Coordinator instance — i.e. for the lifetime of that Coordinator, until the logical session is destroyed/re-created. This partially implements the spec's explicit anti-duplicate policy for unknown create results; there is no on-device trigger evidence. Outer verdict: confirmed static limitation / to-be-verified runtime risk, NOT the current white-screen root cause; no candidate modification started.
findings.actionable: None. Outer has ruled this a confirmed static limitation / pending runtime risk; do NOT propose unlatching unknown-create results generically (that policy is contractual). No candidate change.
